description: The current Operator atomically sets standing enablement rules and matching catalog flags. selector dimensions provider, runtime, model_family_prefix, exact model and effort combine with AND; absent dimensions are wildcards. enabled is a strict boolean. only=true with enabled=true replaces the whole policy with default-off and matching-on in one transaction. Normal set appends a rule, correct replaces rule_id, retire or clear with rule_id removes that rule, and clear without rule_id restores explicit default-on. Read policy first and supply its updated_at as expected_updated_at; explicit null creates the uninitialized policy. A nonempty reason and server-derived current Operator identity are required. Zero current matches is advisory and retains the rule for future models. Existing catalog writers preserve flags and new cells evaluate standing rules. Policy, flags and full immutable snapshots in existing refresh/observation audit tables commit or roll back together. No allowance telemetry participates.
embedding_description: Control which AI model and reasoning effort combinations may receive work by enabling or disabling individual models or groups, selecting only a matching family, and correcting or clearing durable operator choices with atomic changes and retained history.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Current rules and updated_at, visible cells and provenance, bounded append-only policy history, allocated rule_id and run_id; warnings for uninitialized or zero-match cases.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the current policy decisions and provenance clearly. Preserve full immutable history in evidence; explain advisories without blocking progress.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use the current updated_at premise for subsequent Operator corrections; never bypass disabled cells with a pin.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Typed StateManagementInterface catalog policy lifecycle; no network, deployment, drain or session actions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: operator_required/authentication/identity failures: invoke as the currently bound Operator. Do not supply actor identity. stale_policy_state/stale_cell_state: read current policy/catalog and decide again with its premise; nothing partially commits. parameter_invalid: correct selector, booleans, action, reason or missing expected_updated_at. rule_not_found: use current rule identifiers. policy_invalid: inspect malformed persisted policy as an integrity error; do not reset silently.
